caseNameFull: Bradey, Administratrix v. United States, as represented by War Shipping Administration
attorneys: Mr. Simone N. Gazan for petitioner., Solicitor General McGrath and Mr. Paul A. Sweeney for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
